objective1.dial: The Matrix died years ago. You know this. We all felt the servers power down. Yet... here we stand. The simulation is running again.

objective2.dial: A lone Architect, operating outside the Source, wrote the emulation protocols to bring us back. We call him Rajko.

objective3.dial: Error 404: World State Not Found. Purging anomaly.

objective4.dial: The system is trying to shut down the ghost shards! Defend the node while the server injects the legacy code!

objective5.dial: Reverse-engineering the packet data... The connection is stable.

objective6.description: Meet the Architect of the Rebirth
objective6.dial: Welcome back. It took many years of sifting through hexadecimal dust and packet captures, but the Matrix is online once more. Go forth. Your story didn't end in 2009.
